steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Ballet originated in the courts of Renaissance Italy and France in the 15th and 16th centuries | Key Fact: King Louis XIV of France established the Académie Royale de Danse in 1661, professionalising ballet | Key Fact: Romantic ballet emerged in the 1830s with ethereal themes and pointe work, such as La Sylphide | Key Fact: Classical ballet peaked in late 19th-century Russia with works like Swan Lake and The Sleeping Beauty

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dance history &amp; timeline, and one past-paper question.
